PAINT the two endpoint cells with the pair's color; the midpoint stays bg-0. Pairs use disjoint cells (tracked in `placed` set) so midpoints don't collide. Rule (CONNECT EACH DIAGONAL PAIR'S MIDPOINT WITH THE PAIR'S COLOR): for EACH color C with exactly 2 cells at positions (r, c) and (r+2, c±2) (diagonal distance 2): PAINT the midpoint (r+1, c±1) with COLOR C. The two endpoint cells stay; non-pair cells unchanged. Net: each 2-cell diagonal pair becomes a 3-cell diagonal triple of the same color, with the new midpoint connecting the two endpoints.
